message.reasoning:
I need to make a Monopoly decision.

I'm player p2 with $1075 and hotels on the red and dark blue monopolies. p4 has only $293 and is at Income Tax with a brown monopoly. Most of my properties are mortgaged.

Atlantic Avenue is unowned. I cannot build or mortgage anything. My red and dark blue hotels already overwhelm p4 even after liquidation, so I should avoid completing their color groups through trades.

Unmortgaging orange properties would burn cash I need to survive a $450 hotel rent on Baltic. I'm calculating p4's exact liquidation value from their brown hotels.

p4's liquidation value is now roughly $753. Their brown hotels, utilities, and deeds are worth $460. My hotel rents total $5,700.

p4 cannot survive the red and dark blue hotel rents even after collecting $200 from passing GO. I am checking the board order to see if they can land on those properties.

A roll of 2-12 from Income Tax lands on Oriental, Chance, Vermont, Connecticut, Just Visiting, St. Charles, and Electric. Most are mortgaged or belong to p4. This is my POST_TURN_ACTION decision.

I am mapping the exact board indices to confirm p4 cannot land on my red hotels from Income Tax.

p4 cannot land on my hotels from Income Tax. Their roll only reaches Oriental, St. Charles, and Electric. I will roll from Indiana next.

From Indiana, a roll of 5 lands on Water Works and would cost p4 rent. The other spaces are either mortgaged properties or unowned.

The only rent risk next turn is Water Works, costing $50 if I roll a 5. I am calculating unmortgage costs for the remaining properties, which range from $55 to $176.

Unmortgaging any remaining properties would not help. Most color groups lack monopolies, and the reds are already hotels. The only unmortgageable properties are the railroads.

No full railroad set exists. Unmortgaging would burn cash for little rent return. I can afford a $450 Baltic hotel rent even after spending some cash. The only strategic reason to unmortgage is to collect rent if p4 lands on those properties.

I am now considering a trade with p4 to acquire their brown monopoly. This would remove the only color group that could threaten my hotels.

I realized that giving p4 cash would actually help them survive my hotels, not hurt me. Their liquidation value is only about $753, so they cannot afford a $1050 red hotel rent without extra cash. I need to find a trade offer that is appealing enough for them to accept the brown monopoly without giving them the money they need to stay in the game.

I realized p4's brown hotels likely cannot be traded without selling buildings first. I cannot force them to do that. Trading my mortgaged properties to them would complete their green monopoly, which would help them survive my hotels instead of hurting me.

I confirmed that trading my mortgaged properties to p4 would complete their green, pink, and light blue monopolies. None of these trades benefit me. I will not offer cash either.
